classification.difficultyReason: Interpret arrow directions and apply triangle and parallelogram laws, including reversed vectors.

content.prompt: Write vector $\underset{\sim}{c}$ in terms of $\underset{\sim}{a}$ and $\underset{\sim}{b}$ for each diagram.

spec.description: Triangle with directed sides a then b and resultant c. Ordinary source blue arrows are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: a: L to T; b: T to R; c: L to R. Vertex identifiers are unprinted.
spec.answerVisibility: All arrows and vector labels are permanent givens; no answer expression is printed.

answer.worked:
Following $\underset{\sim}{a}$ then $\underset{\sim}{b}$ tip to tail gives $\underset{\sim}{c}$.
$$\underset{\sim}{c}=\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b}$$

spec.description: Triangle with a and b sharing a tail, and c directed from the head of a to the head of b. Ordinary source blue arrows are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: a: B to L; b: B to R; c: L to R.

answer.worked:
From the tail of $\underset{\sim}{c}$, follow $-\underset{\sim}{a}$ then $\underset{\sim}{b}$.
$$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{c}&=-\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b}\\\underset{\sim}{c}&=\underset{\sim}{b}-\underset{\sim}{a}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Triangle matching 7b except c points from the head of b to the head of a. Ordinary source blue arrows are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: a: B to L; b: B to R; c: R to L.

answer.worked:
From the tail of $\underset{\sim}{c}$, follow $-\underset{\sim}{b}$ then $\underset{\sim}{a}$.
$$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{c}&=-\underset{\sim}{b}+\underset{\sim}{a}\\\underset{\sim}{c}&=\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Tall slanted parallelogram with two tip-to-tail boundary paths and upward diagonal c. Ordinary source blue arrows are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: B to L is b; B to R is a; L to T equals a; R to T equals b; c is B to T.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; opposite boundary arrows have no printed vector labels.

answer.worked:
The parallelogram diagonal is the resultant of the two adjacent vectors.
$$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{c}&=\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b}\\\underset{\sim}{c}&=\underset{\sim}{b}+\underset{\sim}{a}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Wide slanted parallelogram; diagonal c points left from the head of a to the head of b. Ordinary source blue arrows are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: B to L is b; B to R is a; L to T equals a; R to T equals b; c is R to L.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; opposite boundary arrows are unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Follow $-\underset{\sim}{a}$ from the right vertex to the bottom vertex, then $\underset{\sim}{b}$ to the left vertex.
$$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{c}&=-\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b}\\\underset{\sim}{c}&=\underset{\sim}{b}-\underset{\sim}{a}\end{aligned}$$
